mBuff.mDescription:
Celestial FlameAurelion Sol is channeling his dragon breath onto you.
"The power of a sun, in your face."

Return to StardustAurelion Sol has knocked you up.
"That should do the trick."

Meteor ShoweredAurelion Sol has stunned you.
"Stunned? Yes I am quite the sight to behold. And also very smart."

Inescapable FateYou are being dragged into Aurelion Sol's black hole.
"I've seen how you use the life I've breathed into you, I'll be taking it back now."

mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Earn a cash out of stacks by taking down Smolder.

AurelionSol Contribution: @f1@
Smolder Contribution: @f2@
Reward: @f3@

(Reward Calculation: Combined stacks / 4 with a min-max of 15-60)

mBuff.mDescription:
Shockwave and AweYou've been slowed by Aurelion Sol's shockwave.
"Sometimes there are minor ripple effects when you toss pebbles around."

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: “(scolding mom roar) But Moomm… I'm already practicing e-ver-y day!” Smolder still has much to learn. Aurelion Sol collects the stacks reward.

“Take notes, hatchling.” Aurelion Sol has taught young Smolder an important lesson and earned himself a cash out of stacks.

Gain all the stacks Smolder and you banked during the quest for a total of @f3@ stacks.

AurelionSol Contribution: @f1@
Smolder Contribution: @f2@

mBuff.mDescription:
SupernovaA black hole has been summoned.
"Even in death, my creations burn brighter than most other lifeforms."

mLocKeys.keySummary: Aurelion Sol summons a black hole, damaging enemies and slowly pulling them toward its center. This ability grants Stardust each time an enemy dies within the black hole and for each second an enemy champion is caught inside it. The center of the black hole executes enemies who are below a certain percentage of their maximum health. Stardust increases Singularity's area as well as the execution threshold.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Aurelion Sol summons a black hole, dealing @DamagePerSecond@ magic damage per second and Dragging enemies towards the center for @Duration@ seconds. Enemies in the center below @CurrentExecutionThreshold@% max Health die instantly.

The black hole absorbs Stardust when enemies die within it and each second an enemy champion is inside.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
This Ability's cast range is @LevelBasedRangeScaling@.
Lane minions and jungle monsters inside have 0 Movement Speed.
Epic monsters cannot be executed.
Absorbs @ChampionMassPerSecond@ Stardust per second from Champions.
Absorbs Stardust from units that die in the black hole:
  • Champions: @ChampionCountBonus@ Stardust
  • Epic monsters: @EpicMonsterCountBonus@ Stardust
  • Large monsters: @LargeMonsterCountBonus@ Stardust
  • Siege minions: @LargeMinionCountBonus@ Stardust
  • Minions and small monsters: @MinionMassDeath@ Stardust

mLocKeys.keySummary: Aurelion Sol's damaging Abilities break down enemies into stacks of <font color='#3458eb'>Stardust</font>, which permanently improves each of his abilities.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Aurelion Sol's damaging Abilities break down enemies into Stardust, which improves his Abilities.
  • {{Spell_AurelionSolQ_Name}}: Bursts deal an additional @QPassiveScaling@ max Health magic damage
  • {{Spell_AurelionSolW_Name}}: @f2.1@% increased distance.
  • {{Spell_AurelionSolE_Name}}: @f3.1@% increased area and @EPassiveScalingExecute@ bonus execute threshold.
  • {{Spell_AurelionSolR1_Name}} and {{Spell_AurelionSolR2_Name}}: @f4.1@% increased area.

    • Aurelion Sol has acquired Stardust: @f1@

mBuff.mDescription:
Eternal StarfireAurelion Sol is channeling his dragon breath.
"Deadly with a refreshing minty scent."

mLocKeys.keySummary: Aurelion Sol channels his dragon breath for a few seconds, damaging the first enemy hit and splashing reduced damage onto nearby enemies. Each second the breath is channeled directly at an enemy will deal bonus damage, which is improved by the amount of Stardust that's been collected. This ability collects Stardust if the target is a champion.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Aurelion Sol breathes starfire for up to @MaxChannelDuration@ seconds, dealing @DamagePerSecond@ magic damage per second to the first enemy hit and @AOEModifier*100@% of the damage to surrounding enemies.

Each full second of breath on the same enemy deals a burst of @BurstDamage@ magic damage plus @BurstBonusTrueDamageToChamps@ max Health magic damage and absorbs @QMassStolen@ Stardust if they are a champion.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
This Ability's range is @LevelBasedRangeScaling@.
Canceling this Ability within 0.25 seconds of casting it will lock the Ability for 1 second.
Minimum mana cost of @ManaCostPerSecond@ per cast.
Percent damage deals a max of @MonsterDamageCap@ magic damage against jungle monsters.

mBuff.mDescription:
Meteor ShowerAurelion Sol is plucking a star down from the heavens.
"You never know where these little rocks will land."

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Falling Star: Aurelion Sol crashes a star into the earth. This impact deals magic damage and stuns enemies while also granting Stardust for each enemy champion it hits. Gathering enough Stardust transforms Aurelion Sol's next Falling Star into The Skies Descend.

The Skies Descend: Aurelion Sol drags a giant star down from the heavens with an increased impact zone and increased damage, knocking up enemies rather than stunning them. A shockwave then spreads from the edge of the impact zone, which damages and slows the enemies it hits. Stardust increases the impact area of both Falling Star and The Skies Descend.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Aurelion Sol plucks a star from the heavens and crashes it into the earth, dealing @MaxDamageTooltip@ magic damage, Stunning enemies @StunDuration@ second, and absorbing @MassStolen@ Stardust for each champion hit.

Gathering @CalamityStacks@ Stardust transforms the next {{Spell_AurelionSolR1_Name}} into {{Spell_AurelionSolR2_Name}}.

{{Spell_AurelionSolR2_Name}}: Aurelion Sol drags a constellation's worth of fury down from the cosmos, dealing @R2Damage@ magic damage in a larger area, Knocking Up enemies hit for @StunDuration@ second, and unleashing a massive shockwave that deals @ShockwaveDamage@ magic damage to champions and Epic Monsters and Slows all enemies hit by @ShockwaveSlow*100@% for 1 second.

mBuff.mDescription:
Cosmic InspirationAurelion Sol is dragging a constellation's worth of fury down from the heavens.
"The ending of their story is quite clear."

Across the UniverseAurelion Sol is flying.
"My revenge has long been foretold and waiting has proved to be quite the bore."

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Aurelion Sol flies over terrain in a targeted direction. While in this state, he can cast other abilities. Breath of Light no longer has a cooldown or maximum channel duration and deals increased damage while flying.

Astral Flight's remaining cooldown is reduced whenever an enemy champion dies after being recently damaged by Aurelion Sol.

Stardust increases Astral Flight's maximum range.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Aurelion Sol flies in a direction. While flying, {{Spell_AurelionSolQ_Name}} has no Cooldown, no max channel duration, and its flat damage is increased by @TrueDamageBonus*100@%.

Takedowns on champions within @ResetWindow@ seconds of damaging them refunds @TooltipTakedownCooldownMultiplier@% of this Ability's Cooldown.

Recast: End flight early.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Casting {{Spell_AurelionSolQ_Name}} while flying reduces flight speed by 50%.
Flight speed is @DashSpeed@.

mBuff.mDescription:
Across the UniverseAurelion Sol is flying.
"My revenge has long been foretold and waiting has proved to be quite the bore."
